name: Old City of Acre
description: Acre is a walled port town on Israel's Mediterranean coast, at the tip of Haifa Bay, and people have lived here continuously since Phoenician times. Its Ottoman-era streets hold a citadel, mosques, caravanserais and bathhouses. Beneath and beside them lies the nearly intact Crusader capital of 1104–1291, whose vaulted halls you can walk through underground.
